incident-bot: PAGED: Severity=high — eu-west-1: auth provider timeouts causing elevated 5xx and latency for Hosted API + Dedicated pools. Metrics: auth latency p95 > 6s, 5xx spike from 01:03Z. Pager sent to @Priya (on-call). :rotating_light:

Priya (on-call): seeing it. thanks. prioritizing. quick ask: is this external OAuth (third-party) or our cred-broker?

Dan (infra): confirmed external oauth provider (oauth-1stparty.example.com) is returning 504s from multiple AZs. Our cred-broker calls -> 504 -> cascade to client requests. sample curl from edge node:```curl -i https://oauth-1stparty.example.com/token -H 'Authorization: Basic ***'``` returns 504/timeout repeatedly.

Priya (on-call): ok. immediate mitigations i think: 1) enable credential-cache fallback on edge (serve cached token for short TTL), 2) route new auth requests to oauth-secondary (fallback region), 3) increase credential call timeout + retry with jitter. can someone run the switches?

Leo (sre): I can flip routing rules for Hosted API routes (edge auth proxy) to prefer oauth-secondary if oauth-primary returns >10% 5xx. Pushing a Canary rollout now. Running command:```/ops/routing/set-auth-fallback --region eu-west-1 --primary oauth-1stparty --secondary oauth-secondary --threshold 0.10``` will monitor for 5m before full switch.

Dan (infra): also bumped cred-broker timeout from 2s -> 5s and added exponential backoff. Pushed to config on prod cred-broker:```env.CRED_TIMEOUT=5s
env.CRED_RETRIES=3
env.RETRY_JITTER=0.2```

Emma (support): heads-up: support is seeing ~120 customer error reports (mostly 502/503) in EU. Tier2 flagged 3 Dedicated customers reporting SLA breaches. I'm drafting a status message to affected customers. Any ETA on mitigation?

Priya (on-call): estimate 20-30m to confirm fallback stabilizes error rate. Leo, confirm when canary passes. EMMA: please send preliminary message: we are investigating auth provider timeouts, mitigation in progress, we'll update in 30m. keep tone: factual, apologetic, include workaround (retry).

Leo (sre): canary OK after 6m: auth 5xx dropped from 12% -> 2% for routed traffic. Initiating full rollout to eu-west-1 edge proxies. Monitoring token cache hitrate and errorbudget.

Dan (infra): post-rollout: cred-broker error rate back to baseline. Observability shows increased latency for initial token fetch for some flows due to retries, but overall client-facing 5xx down 85%.

Priya (on-call): great. contacting the oauth provider support channel now — sent tracing info + request ids. They acknowledged and are investigating DB replicas in eu-west.

Emma (support): customer update posted to status.redwood.com and sent to affected customers. Slack DM to Sales for enterprise customers.

Alice (product): any known feature impact (tool-calling, streaming)? should we pause new canary rollouts in eu-west until postmortem?

Priya (on-call): streaming appears fine once token acquired. recommend pausing noncritical rollouts in eu-west for 24h. I'll open incident-bridge for postmortem items and owner assignments.

incident-bot: Severity downgraded -> medium. Root-cause: external oauth provider experiencing regional DB replica lag causing timeouts (vendor reports). Temporary mitigation: routing to oauth-secondary + cred-broker retries + token-cache fallback.

Leo (sre): creating follow-up tasks: - routing hardening (LRU token cache, better health checks) - add automated fallback when auth 5xx > 5% - add observability alert for external_auth_5xx_rate.

Dan (infra): note for postmortem: we should evaluate short-lived token local caching for Dedicated pools to avoid cascading failures. Putting a spike ticket in infra backlog.

Priya (on-call): handing off to Leo for post-incident monitoring and to Emma for customer comms. I'll stay on call for 30m. If error rate rises above 3%, re-alert.

Emma (support): acknowledged. will monitor support queue and update customers if anything changes.

incident-bot: Incident closed from active -> monitoring at 1768883899. Postmortem requested: owner=Priya, due=+72h. :white_check_mark:
